name: Jackknife
summary: Lying on the back with hands in the straps. The arms press down, the legs go over the head, then the hips and legs shoot up to the ceiling before the spine rolls down slowly.
steps: Headrest down. Lie on the back, hands in the short loops, arms pressed to the carriage beside the hips, legs straight up.
Breathe in to carry the legs over the head until they are level with the floor, weight across the shoulders.
Breathe out to lift the hips and reach the legs straight up, toes over the eyes.
Breathe in, then roll down through the spine with the legs staying close; lower the legs to finish.

layers.title: Overhead only
layers.text: Stop with the legs level; no lift.

layers.title: Full jackknife
layers.text: Lift the hips to a long line.

cautions.note: Body weight rests near the neck.
Lighter spring and a smaller range.

cues:
Weight on the shoulders, never the neck.
Arms stay long and heavy on the carriage.
Roll down slowly; the carriage should hardly move.
Head stays still: no looking around.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.

variations.name: Overhead (no lift)
variations.note: Roll over and back without the lift to vertical.

variations.name: Lift less high
variations.note: Stay balanced over the shoulders instead of going to vertical.
